parsed.notes:
Dein Skillset is the qualifications section; no section heading makes it optional. The inline phrase 'sind von Vorteil' makes modern architectures, cloud technologies and that AI/ML mention optional.
AI/ML is required overall because the earlier hands-on implementation qualification explicitly asks for AI solutions; the AI-or-automation alternatives are both retained as named skills.
Datenmodelle is mapped literally to data-modeling, and modern architectures to software-architecture in this technical context.
SAP process areas are domain knowledge and are excluded. SAP technologies without taxonomy entries are listed as unmapped.
Responsibilities, company descriptions and the Schlagworte search-keyword list are not treated as candidate qualifications.
The unspecified completed degree maps to bachelor; 'oder vergleichbare Qualifikation' establishes an accepted equivalent.
